Alpha magic：用于视觉特效和设计的即时透明背景视频。

适合谁：希望在 ComfyUI 中使用此管道而无需从头开始组装节点的创建者。不适合：零调整的一键结果 - 您仍然可以选择输入、提示和设置。

在 RunComfy 上打开预加载的工作流程

在 RunComfy（浏览器）上打开预加载的工作流程

为什么首先选择 RunComfy
- 更少的丢失节点意外— 在本地镜像之前在托管环境中运行该图。
- GPU 快速试用— 如果您的本地 VRAM 或安装时间是瓶颈，则很有用。
- 与发布的 JSON 匹配— 该 zip 遵循与您可以在 RunComfy 上打开的相同的可运行工作流程。

当下载本地 ComfyUI 有意义时— 您希望完全控制磁盘上的模型、批处理脚本或离线运行。

使用方法（本地ComfyUI）
1. 在标记的加载器节点中加载输入（图像/视频/音频）。
2、设置提示、分辨率、种子；从短暂的试运行开始。
3. 从图中所示的保存/写入节点导出。

期望— 第一次运行可能会拉动大重量;云运行可能需要免费的 RunComfy 帐户.

概述

此工作流程可帮助您生成具有内置透明度的高质量视频剪辑，无需手动遮罩或绿屏移除。您可以轻松地将角色、对象或动画元素放置在您选择的任何背景上。其输出高度灵活，非常适合视觉特效、动态图形和合成工作。通过使用现成的透明视频资源，您将节省时间并简化您的创作流程。它专为专业人士设计，确保无缝集成到现有设计流程中。它基于 Wan 2.1 模型构建，每次渲染都能提供保真度和精度。

重要节点：

Comfyui Wan Alpha工作流程中的关键节点

空混源潜视频(#40)
- 作用：定义生成剪辑的空间和时间分辨率。调音宽度, 高度, 框架, 和帧率以匹配交货。更大的画布和更长的持续时间提高了 VRAM 需求；考虑使用较短的草稿进行外观开发，然后扩大规模以进行最终确定。

KS采样器(#3)
- 作用：Wan Alpha 的主要降噪器。调整种子为了探索，步骤以速度换取细节，采样器和调度程序为了稳定性，以及cfg平衡快速坚持与自然运动。通过 LightX2V LoRA active，您可以减少步骤通过分步蒸馏，显着提高质量，同时保持质量。有关快速采样的上下文，请参阅 LightX2V。型号TC/LightX2V

LoraLoader仅模型(#59)
- 作用：加载加速Wan2.1采样的LightX2V LoRA。使用实力如果您看到过度锐化或节奏伪影，请控制以混合其效果。保持该 LoRA 最接近链中的基本模型，以便下游 LoRA 继承其速度优势。

LoraLoader仅模型(#65)
- 作用：加载额外的 LoRA 以进行样式或领域细化。中等实力避免压倒运动连贯性；与您的提示结合起来而不是替换它。如果出现伪影，请在更换采样器之前降低此 LoRA。

VAE加载器(#39) RGB
- 作用：提供使用的RGB VAERGB VAE 解码（＃8）。将此与 Wan-Alpha alpha VAE 配对，以确保两个解码器一致地解释潜在的。交换到不相关的 VAE 可能会使边缘错位或软化透明度。 Wan-Alpha 报告中提供了 RGB-alpha 联合设计的背景信息。Wan-Alpha (arXiv)

VAE加载器(#51) 阿尔法
- 作用：提供使用的 alpha VAEAlpha VAE 解码（＃52）。它从与 RGB 相同的潜在空间重建遮罩，因此透明度与运动和细节相匹配。如果您自定义 VAE，请测试 RGB 和 Alpha 是否仍然在子像素边缘（如头发）上对齐。

…

注释

ComfyUI 中的 Wan Alpha | Alpha 通道视频工作流程— 参见舒适运行页面了解最新的节点要求。

o.en:
Alpha magic: instant transparent background videos for VFX and design.

Who it's for:creators who want this pipeline in ComfyUI without assembling nodes from scratch.Not for:one-click results with zero tuning — you still choose inputs, prompts, and settings.

Open preloaded workflow on RunComfy

Open preloaded workflow on RunComfy (browser)

Why RunComfy first
- Fewer missing-node surprises— run the graph in a managed environment before you mirror it locally.
- Quick GPU tryout— useful if your local VRAM or install time is the bottleneck.
- Matches the published JSON— the zip follows the same runnable workflow you can open on RunComfy.

When downloading for local ComfyUI makes sense— you want full control over models on disk, batch scripting, or offline runs.

How to use (local ComfyUI)
1. Load inputs (images/video/audio) in the marked loader nodes.
2. Set prompts, resolution, and seeds; start with a short test run.
3. Export from the Save / Write nodes shown in the graph.

Expectations— First run may pulllarge weights; cloud runs may require afree RunComfy account.

Overview

This workflow helps you generate high-quality video clips with built-in transparency, eliminating the need for manual masking or green screen removal. You can easily place characters, objects, or animated elements over any background of your choice. Its output is highly flexible, making it perfect for VFX, motion graphics, and compositing work. You will save time and streamline your creative process by working with ready-to-use transparent video assets. Designed for professionals, it ensures seamless integration into existing design pipelines. Built on the Wan 2.1 model, it delivers fidelity and precision with each render.

Important nodes:

Key nodes in Comfyui Wan Alpha workflow

EmptyHunyuanLatentVideo(#40)
- Role: defines spatial and temporal resolution of the generated clip. Tunewidth, height, frames, andfpsto match delivery. Larger canvases and longer durations raise VRAM needs; consider shorter drafts for look development, then scale up for finals.

KSampler(#3)
- Role: the main denoiser for Wan Alpha. Adjustseedfor explorations,stepsto trade speed for detail,samplerandschedulerfor stability, andcfgto balance prompt adherence with natural motion. With LightX2V LoRA active, you can reducestepssignificantly while preserving quality thanks to step-distillation. See LightX2V for context on fast sampling.ModelTC/LightX2V

LoraLoaderModelOnly(#59)
- Role: loads the LightX2V LoRA that accelerates Wan2.1 sampling. Use thestrengthcontrol to blend its effect if you see oversharpening or tempo artifacts. Keep this LoRA closest to the base model in the chain so downstream LoRAs inherit its speed benefits.

LoraLoaderModelOnly(#65)
- Role: loads an additional LoRA for style or domain refinement. Moderatestrengthto avoid overpowering motion coherence; combine with your prompt rather than replacing it. If artifacts appear, lower this LoRA before changing the sampler.

VAELoader(#39) RGB
- Role: provides the RGB VAE used byRGB VAE Decode(#8). Keep this paired with the Wan‑Alpha alpha VAE to ensure both decoders interpret latents coherently. Swapping to unrelated VAEs can misalign edges or soften transparency. Background on the joint RGB–alpha design is in the Wan‑Alpha report.Wan‑Alpha (arXiv)

VAELoader(#51) Alpha
- Role: provides the alpha VAE used byAlpha VAE Decode(#52). It reconstructs the matte from the same latent space as RGB so transparency matches motion and detail. If you customize VAEs, test that RGB and alpha still align on subpixel edges like hair.
